description: Section headings the reader shows above a paragraph, keyed by the record that opens it. They are editorial aids, not translation: they are not in the source, they are written from Open Word Bible's own wording, and they may use reader settings. Every heading is an AI draft until a named reviewer approves it.

HEB.1.1.s1.en: God has spoken by the Son
HEB.1.1.s1.hi: परमेश्वर ने पुत्र के द्वारा बात की है

HEB.1.5.s1.en: The Son is greater than the angels

HEB.2.10.s1.en: The pioneer who leads many to glory

HEB.2.14.s1.en: Made like us in every way
HEB.2.14.s1.hi: हर बात में हमारे समान बनाए गए

HEB.3.7.s1.hi: आज, यदि तुम उनकी आवाज़ सुनो

HEB.6.13.s1.hi: परमेश्वर की प्रतिज्ञा और परमेश्वर की शपथ

HEB.7.11.s1.hi: एक दूसरा याजक और एक उत्तम आशा

HEB.12.1.s1.en: Running with our eyes on Jesus
